verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents LLM tracing, evaluations, and usage and cost analysis. No item describes configuring alerts or monitors on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops, and none mentions routing notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, or email. Evaluations and cost analysis are adjacent features, not alerting, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email
